get.summary: Every address a red label propagated to from an origin address, as a complete edge list
get.description: Returns every propagation edge whose originAddress matches the path param, ordered txTimestamp ASC then address ASC, sufficient to draw a trace chart with no further calls. offset is applied AFTER an exhaustive, service-side sort of the whole partition - not a cheap deep-paging primitive; cost is proportional to partition size, not to offset. Org-blind (requires READ_ADDRESS_GLOBAL): returns edges across all organizations, not just the caller's own.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max rows returned (default 10000, max 10000). offset is applied AFTER an exhaustive, service-side-sorted read of the whole origin partition - it is not a cheap deep-paging primitive, and the cost is proportional to partition size, not to offset.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip after sorting by txTimestamp ASC, address ASC (default 0).

get.summary: The direct children of one address in a propagation tree (branch isolation)
get.description: Returns only the edges whose previousAddress matches the path param - the direct children of that node, not the whole subtree beneath it. Same ordering and offset cost note as the origin lookup. Org-blind (requires READ_ADDRESS_GLOBAL): returns edges across all organizations, not just the caller's own.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max rows returned (default 10000, max 10000). offset is applied AFTER an exhaustive, service-side-sorted read of the whole previous-address partition - it is not a cheap deep-paging primitive, and the cost is proportional to partition size, not to offset.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip after sorting by txTimestamp ASC, address ASC (default 0).

info.title: BLACKLIST SERVICE
info.description: This is the Address Blacklist API documentation

isPublicInfo.description: Whether address is public or not

enableSniffer.description: Whether the sniffer should watch this address, independent of type/severity. Absent on write = preserve stored value; null = clear. Always a boolean on read (null reads as false).

originAddress.description: Root address a propagated label originated from. Absent on write = preserve stored value; null = clear.

previousAddress.description: Immediate parent address this label propagated from. Part of the provenance quartet (previousAddress/txHash/txBlockchain/txTimestamp): must be all present, all explicitly null, or all absent together.

txHash.description: On-chain transaction hash that carried the propagation.

txTimestamp.description: On-chain transaction time (ISO-8601), NOT the label write time (createdAt).

isPublicInfo.description: Whether entity is public or not
